description: Run several read-only privacy API operations in one call, instead of many single-tool calls. Each operation names an allowlisted GET path template, parameters, and optional select, filter, sort, limit, or count_only shaping. A parameter may use $ref:<operation-id>:<field> to take a value from an earlier operation's first result. Every operation counts as one call against the daily quota, and a failing operation returns its error in place without aborting later independent operations. Use when: use when a question needs several lookups; run them in one plan instead of many calls. Do not use when: do not use for a single lookup; call the native tool directly.

operations.description: Operations to run in order, at most 10. Each has id, path, params, and optional select, filter, sort, limit, count_only.

count_only.description: Return only the count, not the items.

filter.description: Filter with field, op (eq, contains, gte, lte), and value.

id.description: Operation id, used as the results key and for $ref.

params.description: Operation parameters, strings, numbers, or booleans only; a $ref string is allowed.

path.description: Allowlisted GET path template, for example /enforcement or /glossary/{term}.

sort.description: Sort value the REST endpoint already accepts, for example date_desc.

name: privacy_execute_plan
title: Execute a privacy API plan
